source_review.callback_stub_token_guard: All three callback dispatchers call CHECK_RETURN_RET(data.ReadInterfaceToken() != GetDescriptor(), errCode) before switch dispatch. Exact macro expansion is not included in the component snapshot.
source_review.proxy_pairing: Photo and thumbnail proxies write GetDescriptor() to MessageParcel before SendRequest. Window-manager agent is registered through CameraWindowManagerClient with WINDOW_MANAGER_AGENT_TYPE_CAMERA_WINDOW.
source_review.build_context: GN source lists include photo/thumbnail callback stubs under camera_framework targets, the window-manager callback stub under camera_service, and hcamera_service.cpp in install-enabled camera_service. This is source build configuration, not a verified product build.
source_review.authorization: CreateCameraDevice contains OHOS_PERMISSION_CAMERA CheckPermission result guard and IsInForeGround guard before device creation; CAMERA_SHARED is a separate privilege predicate. Macro expansion, product policy, caller identity and actual caller reachability are unverified.
source_review.fixed_source: No trusted fixed source was established.
